descriptions.notStarted: Cassandra says she'll give you a pair of gloves to celebrate MapleStory's 6th Anniversary. Go talk to Cassandra to find out more.
descriptions.inProgress: Cassandra claims that she can make gloves out of maple leaves. Go collect some maple leaves!
descriptions.completed: You were told if you have Maple Gage currently equipped or in your Inventory, you can't receive it again. Failed equipment should be thrown away.
